references.text: The same prohibition against perverting justice and accepting bribes, given in the Book of the Covenant
Command not to show partiality in legal decisions, neither for the lowly nor for the powerful
Proverb warning against accepting bribes to twist the course of justice
Warning against showing bias in judgment
The Preacher warns that bribery corrupts wisdom and destroys the heart
Prophetic judgment against leaders who accept bribes and fail to defend the defenseless
Woe to those who acquit the guilty for the sake of bribes
Prophetic accusation against leaders who judge for a bribe
Peter confirms that God shows no partiality, a principle rooted in the Mosaic Law
Warning against showing favoritism in the church, which violates the command for impartial justice
